tagline: Any HTML, printed as a receipt — one custom element, zero dependencies
description: One custom element that renders anything you wrap in it as a thermal receipt, then exports it as a PNG. Zero dependencies, no build step, MIT.

identity.concept: Torn: one sheet parted along a jagged diagonal, the halves pulled apart along the perpendicular. The tear is the product's own name and the only event in the mark. It replaces three staggered slabs — the drawing carried over from the nav — which read cold as a text-align glyph and, at the 16px a browser tab serves, as a hamburger menu. Authored at 64 units so the tear is real geometry rather than a stack of rectangles, and rendered at 120/34/16 on both grounds before it was kept; three earlier constructions were binned there for reading as Pac-Man, an ascending scatter plot and a row of download arrows. Square corners, because a receipt has none.
identity.origin: Drawn 2026-08-23 under the logo-designer skill, from the product's one claim — any HTML, printed — not from the previous mark or its description. Two shapes, no plate on the served glyph: the authored fills read var(--color-background), so the mark is the paper on the dark theme and the ink on the light one and owns no hex of its own. src/app/icon.svg is the same drawing on an ink plate for the tab.
identity.grammar: Estate family grammar, from src/components/product-mark.mjs on breachprobe: one #0a0a0a plate at rx 7, one colour (this product's accent), the 0.34 / 0.62 / 1.0 ramp, flat fills only, two to four shapes, nothing thinner than 3 units. Parsed by kynth-ops/video/build-film.mjs, which reads the shapes and the group transform straight out of this file.
identity.wordmark: none — the lockup is this glyph plus the product name as live text, never baked in

colors.note: STARK, TWO THEMES, NO HUE (2026-08-23). The amber #ffa552 recorded here on 2026-08-15 is retired at Isaiah's direction: the product's only artifact is black ink on cream paper, so the site is that and its inverse and nothing else. There is no accent hue anywhere in src/app/theme.css. `accent` and `background` are the DARK theme, which is the default and is declared with no attribute; `accentLight`/`backgroundLight` are the light theme, keyed on html[data-theme="light"]. The accent is positionally the same token in both (--color-background): it is the receipt paper on dark and the ink on light, so every CTA fill, link and the brand mark invert with the page. receiptPaper/receiptInk are the colours tearline.js puts on the paper and do NOT flip — a receipt has no dark mode. The hero backdrop photograph was deleted with the hue; --brand-backdrop is `none`. --color-red survives for error states only, which is a semantic and not an accent.
